## Custom GUI Mod v1.2.1

This release adds the in-game Admin / Test Panel and changes rune awakening input from middle click to left click.

### Added

- Added an in-game Admin / Test Panel opened through server-authorized F8 access.
- Added a dedicated UUID-based admin whitelist independent from the Minecraft server whitelist and operator status.
- Added online player target selection for admin actions.
- Added rune administration tools for reset and filling NORMAL, SILVER and GOLD rune states.
- Added resource administration tools for add, set and zero actions with dynamic resource selection.
- Added custom mob administration for create, spawn relocation and delete operations.
- Added dropdown selectors, paging, summaries and confirmation for destructive actions.

### Changed

- Rune awakening now uses left click on the rune instead of middle click.
- Existing awakening guards and regression coverage were kept in place.

### Fixed

- Fixed Admin / Test Panel text-field alignment so values are padded and vertically centered correctly.

### Other

- CI now also runs on pushes to `main`, so release-state commits are validated after promotion from `develop`.
- The release keeps Minecraft 1.12.2 and Forge 14.23.5.2859 as the supported runtime.
- Client and server must use the same mod version.

### Validation

- Feature branch CI passed before merge.
- The changes were merged into `develop` and its CI passed.
- The persistent local server runtime check passed after the merge into `develop`.
- The changes were promoted from `develop` to `main`.
- CI on `main` is enabled and passed before release preparation.

### Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.12.2
- Forge 14.23.5.2859
- Client and server must use the same mod version.
